title: Titik Akhir
subject: Two first-year chemistry students share one burette in a Pekanbaru campus lab; he keeps overshooting the endpoint to dark pink because he watches her instead of the drops, the assistant makes them start over until dusk, and she steadies his hand on the tap.
caption: Riau Malay zapin with a gambus and marwas groove. Gambus Melayu lute with a short taksim intro and running plucked lines, interlocking marwas hand drums with a loud kopak break at phrase ends, violin doubling the vocal melody with slides, accordion in sustained chords and short fills, soft upright bass. warm intimate acoustic mix with the marwas forward. Male vocal, warm mid register with light Malay cengkok, clearly sung in pantun-style phrasing. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 104 BPM, D minor. Courteous, playful, shy. No rap, no autotune, no trap hi-hats, no EDM synths, no distorted guitar, no Western pop drum kit.
lyrics:
[Intro - gambus taksim and marwas]
[Verse 1]
Laboratorium Pekanbaru siang hari
Satu buret kita pakai berdua
Larutan bening, tinggal setetes lagi
Mataku malah ke arah wajahmu
[Pre-Chorus]
Jangan kau tanya mengapa tanganku gemetar
Kutunggu warna, kau yang kutunggu
[Chorus]
Titik akhir, titik akhir
Merah jambu tua, aku terlewat lagi
Titik akhir, titik akhir
Bukan salah tetes, salah mataku
[Verse 2]
Asisten menggeleng, ulang dari awal
Kita isi lagi, kita catat lagi
Matahari condong ke jendela kaca
Kita masih berdiri di meja yang sama
[Pre-Chorus]
Kau ambil tanganku dari keran itu
Pelan katamu, kali ini bersama
[Chorus]
Titik akhir, titik akhir
Satu tetes saja, warnanya pas
Titik akhir, titik akhir
Merah muda tipis, kita berhasil
[Chorus]
Titik akhir, titik akhir
Kali ini mataku ikut kau jaga
Titik akhir, titik akhir
Di tanganmu tetes terakhir jatuh
[Outro - gambus and marwas fade]
Titik akhir, titik akhir
